title: Separate identity, marriage and ownership records
evidence: Current Person/Account/Case/Party adapters consolidate identity, marriage matching and issued references. The contract requires separate versioned identity, applicant, marriage and reference relations; person ownership on applications is not a direct adapter column. This is not a finding that current own API privacy is broken.
next_action: Backend/governance: map stable person/account/applicant ownership, canonical aliases and immutable reference history before accepting full schema parity. Review allauth/session tables separately.

title: Published questionnaire and declaration provenance
evidence: QuestionnaireVersion combines questionnaire definition and bilingual declaration text. Separate questionnaire/declaration version identities, digests and publication provenance are not direct mapped columns. The reference seed inventory is not a complete approved bilingual applicant form.
next_action: Institution supplies approved bilingual definitions; backend maps immutable declaration identity/digest/publication. Run technical form audit on exact bound production candidates; never synthesize approval from test wording.

title: Typed assertions and stable repeat-entry relations
evidence: The adapter retains immutable AnswerRevision.answers JSON and client repeat UUIDs. Thirteen draft-related contract tables include typed person/marriage/separation assertions, repeat entries, answers and attributed changes. JSON presence does not prove field coverage, normalized relations or backend nested-repeat validation.
next_action: Backend owns typed schema/repeat validation and migration mapping. Reconcile every accepted question and repeat path to its assertion/entry relation, preserving source versions and unknown draft fields.

title: Context, manifest and derivative relations
evidence: Attachment.context and Submission.manifest provide tested adapter behavior. Separate contextual links, relational submission manifest, derivative and access-event structures are not established by the mapped columns. Existing clean-byte and retained-link tests remain valid within their recorded scope.
next_action: Map exact source/version/context/repeat relations and derivative/access retention under backend ownership; preserve current scan gates and private bytes. Independently accept physical storage cleanup and live antivirus.

title: Filing candidate and submission provenance
evidence: CheckoutIntent is a candidate for filing_candidates while also serving as the payment-attempt adapter. Submission retains revision, manifest, attestation and idempotency key, but the contract candidate/declaration/signature/previous-submission links and standalone withdrawal events are not direct mapped columns.
next_action: Backend/governance reconcile candidate and receipt identities, immutable signing evidence and withdrawal audit relations. Keep completed version checks and single-attempt UI; do not re-enable actions from status alone.

title: Separate payment attempts, allocations and refunds
evidence: FeeObligation, CheckoutIntent and PaymentEvent retain adapter financial history. Explicit obligation/candidate/attempt/submission allocation and independently attributed waiver/refund rows are not fully mapped. Current retained checkout recovery tests use controlled provider output, not a charge or callback acceptance.
next_action: Resolve shared CheckoutIntent mapping before migration; reconcile allocation and verified refund provenance. Separately test provider login/payment callbacks and PostgreSQL races, keeping unresolved holds authoritative.

title: Invitation responses reference a version by number
evidence: TestimonyAppointmentVersion is a named table candidate. AppointmentResponse stores appointment_id plus integer version, while the contract response references appointment_version_id and party_id. Actual invitation version/stale-response tests pass; exact relational FK/provenance parity remains unverified.
next_action: Backend maps composite adapter version identity to immutable version-row FK and party provenance. Preserve narrow own response projection and independently accept PostgreSQL invitation policies/delivery.

title: Clinical release and report schema remain consolidated
evidence: ReportRequest.questions, ReportRevision.answers and MedicalRelease.scope implement tested bound own responses and strict disclosure scope. Separate sent-question, evaluation request, release attestation/scope/report/disclosure entities remain adapter/storage candidates. Exact institutional declaration approval is still external to schema or synthetic tests.
next_action: Map retained declaration/version/file/person/purpose/recipient provenance to clinical contract entities; obtain institutional wording approval. Preserve exact consent matching, own privacy and current closure/replay safeguards.

title: Own supplement history and capability are absent
evidence: Actual owner-only supplement POST is verified, but current own application detail does not project supplements or can_supplement. Applicant Supplements requires both, so it intentionally remains unavailable against this backend. The append endpoint has no idempotency key; blind retry could duplicate an addition. Separate appeal root/claim/disposition links also need schema mapping.
next_action: Backend supplies private own attributed supplement history and authoritative can_supplement plus interruption/recovery semantics. Applicant then integrates actual read/append/recovery; do not infer permission from submitted status or automatically retry.

title: Certificate, entitlement and issuance identities
evidence: Decree stores decision/reference/language/signed original/signer/issued time; DecreeRelease stores decree/party/action. Own release and withdrawal byte tests pass. The contract separates certificate, issuance event, entitlement and release identities; those are not established by one decree model or a successful download.
next_action: Backend/governance map exact template/certificate/approval/entitlement/release identities and retain previous decree access. Separately accept genuine signature/issuance and delivery; keep current applicant exact-file withdrawal behavior.
